project.name: osgi/manifests/manifests-port
project.description: The manifests contract — the domain port both worlds depend on: the OSGi manifests-core bundle implements it, the host depends on it. Pure POJO model: the synthesis/explode/update SPIs, their exchange records, NodeEnvContext/NodeEnvContributor, and the shared value/constant types (domain policy + catalog, annotations, the profiles value records). Zero impl, zero pulumi, zero osgi runtime — that purity is what makes it a real OSGi bundle at BUILD time (jar + bnd metadata + per-package @Version), yet at RUNTIME host-loaded and system-exported: the bytes are loaded by the host classloader and the package is exported to the OSGi world by the system bundle (system.packages.extra), never installBundle — so both worlds share ONE copy of the contract. Versioned independently of the reactor GAV via per-package @Version (starts 1.0.0).
